extraction.notes: ESS reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so AFFO fields are null. Reconciliation appears on seq 11 (no printed page) and seq 16 (printed 3); seq 16 used. Figures verified: FFO 253,728 / 66,725.582k shares = $3.80; Core FFO 243,761 / 66,725.582k = $3.65. Judgment calls on categories: 'Gains on sale of real estate and land not included in FFO' combines depreciable and land gains, mapped to property_sale_gain_loss; 'Depreciation attributable to third party ownership and other (2)' mapped to re_depreciation; 'Deferred tax benefit on unconsolidated co-investments (3)' and 'Provision for credit losses' mapped to other; 'Insurance reimbursements, legal settlements, and other, net' mapped to legal (it also includes insurance reimbursements). Zero-value current-quarter lines (Loss on early retirement of debt from unconsolidated co-investment, Co-investment promote income, Income from early redemption of preferred equity investments) omitted. Diluted share count is printed in full (66,725,582), converted to thousands.
